Name: Animal in a box
Author: Squidthulhu1
Description:
Drop into Stardew Valley\Content\Animals

Changes your cat into a little animal inside of a box, the animal will sometimes peek out, look around, and drop little coins (you can't pick up the coins) he also walks around.

I have also made a WaveBank so he doesn't meow like a cat, you can drop this into Stardew Valley\Content\XACT... it will replace the 2 cat sound effects with a sneezing sound and a weird little animal sound, I created both of them with Bfxr.

I will combine WaveBanks on request, just message me at https://community.playstarbound.com/members/squidthulhu1.877824/ the Stardew Valley Forums, or  Squidthulhu#1784 on Discord.
